gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-hoover: Hoover reads sturdy and refined, with ascenders kept short and tight. Nulshock is best at stretching out wide, spacious, bent-paperclip lines, while the text serif is best at keeping its e open and its shapes compact.
gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-quicksand: Stretched and technical: Nulshock spreads wide with an unshaded outline, above Quicksand's tall, bulb-round lowercase and open terminals. Quicksand would read soft and approachable all the way down a page.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One hangs its big-eyed lowercase along the line like clothespins, all in one stroke width. But Nulshock stays stretched and technical, so next to it the body feels quietly professional.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-roboto: Stretched, bold and technical, Nulshock draws uniform strokes, while Roboto opens the mouths of its round letters. Roboto would read clean and contemporary all the way down a long column.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-alpino: Classic and commanding, Oldtimer rounds off like open parentheses. Alpino's tall, casual body makes its ascenders look short, so the cozy lowercase settles in beneath the heading's swell-free downstrokes.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads clean, its s curves opening at both ends, its x-height generous. Oldtimer, round as open parentheses, brings a classic, commanding note to the headings above that lowercase.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. But if Oldtimer is made small, its commanding round forms lose some of their pull next to Paquito.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident, with lowercase standing nearly level with its capitals. Origami holds its sign-painter's brush line at constant width, while Paquito would keep a paragraph feeling approachable.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Origami draws every letter with one unbroken sign-painter's brush line. Noto Sans Tai Tham brings chalk-board lowercase crowding up to the capital line, so paragraphs would read open and contemporary.
gen-dafont-origami-space-grotesk: Origami's single-stroke brush line holds one width through every letter, with a lowercase mass like poured lead type. Dense poured-lead heading, hollow-reed body: that tension is the draw.
